notes: Olam Group — Singapore-listed agri / food ingredients trader (rebrand from Olam International, Jan 2022). Three operating groups: ofi (olam food ingredients — cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts, spices); Olam Agri (grains, oilseeds, edible oils, rice, cotton — sold 64.6% to SALIC in 2024 for US$1.78B); Remaining Olam Group (gestation businesses + corporate). Reports in SGD. FY = calendar year. Net debt heavy due to commodity inventory financing. FY history from Olam annual reports & half-year results announcements via olamgroup.com.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue S$35.8B (+9% YoY), PATMI S$280M. Reorganization plan announced (split into Olam Food Ingredients + Olam Global Agri + Remaining Olam Group).
FY21: Record revenue S$47.2B (+32% YoY), PATMI S$685M. Olam Global Agri sold 35.4% stake to SALIC (Saudi Agricultural Investment) for US$1.24B.
FY22: Revenue S$54.9B record, PATMI S$459M. Rebranded to Olam Group; ofi separation listing plans deferred.
FY23: Revenue S$47.8B (-13%), net loss S$322M on ofi cocoa working capital + Nigeria forex losses. Final dividend slashed.

FY24: Revenue S$36.4B (-24% YoY post Olam Agri deconsolidation; SALIC majority stake completed). Net loss S$810M on cocoa price spike margin squeeze + reorg costs. ofi planning UK + Singapore concurrent listing.
